'''Nadine Hoffmann''' (born 1979) is a German politician serving as a member of the [[Landtag of Thuringia]] since 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/profile/nadine-hoffmann|title=Nadine Hoffmann|work=[[Parliamentwatch]]|language=de}}</ref> She is the group leader of the [[Alternative for Germany]] in the ''[[Kreistag]]'' of [[Hildburghausen (district)|Hildburghausen]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thueringer-landtag.de/en/homepage/deputies/deputies-parliamentary-groups-distribution-of-seats/information-about-members/abgeordneter/nadine-hoffmann/|title=Nadine Hoffmann|publisher=[[Landtag of Thuringia]]|language=de}}</ref>
